guesses.reason: Glossy, short, uniformly black coat on a medium, everyday-cat build with no breed-defining features points to a classic random-bred black shorthair.
The sleek jet-black coat, slender frame, and round eyes echo the Bombay look, though the green rather than copper eyes and longer face make a purebred unlikely.
The fairly large, upright ears, wedge-leaning face, and lean, long-legged body hint at a touch of Oriental-type influence.

breed.appearance: A slender, medium-sized solid black shorthaired cat with a sleek, glossy coat that shows faint brownish highlights in bright light and a few sparse white hairs scattered on the face and muzzle. She has large, upright triangular ears with thin pinkish inner skin, a moderately wedge-shaped face, and round, pale yellow-green eyes. She sits upright and alert with long front legs, neat small paws, and prominent white whiskers fanning out from a dark muzzle.
breed.fun_fact: Black domestic shorthairs are often considered symbols of good luck in places like Scotland and Japan, so Kate might just be your lucky charm!
